name: Unusual logon out of hours (admin)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where Account in (AdminAccounts) | where hour_of_day(TimeGenerated) between (22 .. 5) | where LogonType in (3, 10, 8)
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4624 User IN (admins) NOT wday, _time | where _time >= relative_now(7d) | eval h=strftime(_time,"%H") | where h>=22 OR h<=5
tuning: Needs admin account group baseline; exclude on-call rotations.
